limits: Manual original-image interpretation, not an automatic semantic judge.

space_identity_findings.message: Reference space has no one-to-one candidate counterpart.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound direct original returns from view_image or paired elevation views are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
North assumed up (no north arrow observed on plan).
Interior door heights (Dtop, DoorA, DoorB, DoorC, DoorD) assumed 2.1m; no interior elevation was supplied for these.
Door leaf/swing direction not modeled; only jamb-to-jamb opening width used.

EW1 and EW2 (east-wall small windows, L1 and NE_small_room) use the same 1.0-2.8m height as the matching west/south small windows by analogy; East_view.png's own dimension chain only labels the door and the large window, not these small squares, so this height is an assumption, not a direct East_view reading.

A small square mark on East_view.png near the left (south) end of its 5700mm wall segment, before the door, was not matched to any plan opening: the plan's corresponding south-east room east wall is drawn solid with no window ink. Left unassigned/unresolved.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: NE small room connectivity was corrected using measured ink gaps on P2 and P3 (drawing_differences): it connects to L1 via Dtop and to MidEastRoom via DoorE; no direct opening to the west rooms was found in the ink.
Elevation small square on East_view.png near its left (south) end, inside the 5700mm wall segment, not matched to any plan opening.

Calibration cross-axis check reports x=36.5 px/m vs y=36 px/m (1.38% deviation) and small residuals (~0.11m over 10m in x, ~0.055m over 20m in y) against the supplied anchors. This is within ordinary drawing/rounding tolerance for this plan but was not re-measured at the extension-line ticks; absolute positions may carry up to ~1-2% error.
limits: Single cross-case execution, not repeated success on this whole-building scope.
No internal door height evidence is created by plan matching.
Original-pixel estimates and GT tolerances are independent diagnostics, not surveyed accuracy.
Assumption/evidence consistency requires manual semantic review; no EP or human approval.
